responsibility: Defines the tiny macro layer used to declare RVV builtin availability predicates in the RISC-V vector intrinsic subsystem. Rather than registering builtins or expanding them itself, this header provides the `AVAIL(NAME, COND)` pattern that turns feature tests into `riscv_vector_avail_*` helper functions, which the surrounding vector-builtin tables and registration code can reference to gate intrinsic families on target ISA/extension support.
